name: Custom Shape Suncatcher Acrylic Night Light Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, offering a bright, modern, and elegant decorative finish.
    - Constructed from 2 acrylic panels combined with multiple acrylic spacers, creating a beautiful 3D layered structure with added depth and dimension.
    - Acrylic thickness: ~3mm, providing a sturdy yet lightweight structure for long-term use.
    - The layered acrylic construction enhances the printed artwork and light effect, making the design more vivid and eye-catching both day and night.
    - USB-powered design offers convenient and reliable everyday use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
               +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
               +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
               +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm.
    - Overall thickness: 0.83 in ~ 2.1 cm.
    📌 Note:  The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.  Multiple acrylic spacer sizes are fixed and cannot be changed.

 

  • Lighting Options:
    - Available in 2 light options:
               +) MULTI COLOR – comes with a 7-color button dimmer, allowing you to change and enjoy multiple light colors.
               +) MONOCHROME – comes with a 1-color button dimmer for a simple and elegant lighting effect.
    - Both options are USB powered for convenient connection to laptops, power banks, adapters, and other USB-compatible sources.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports 1-sided printing on both acrylic panels, helping build a layered artwork effect with added visual depth.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative suncatcher display and a personalized night light.
    - Designed to brighten up bedrooms, living rooms, desks, shelves, or memory corners with a warm decorative glow.
    - USB-powered design makes it easy to use with common power sources.
    - Available in multi-color or monochrome lighting to suit different décor styles and personal preferences.
    - Perfect for home decoration, gift giving, and creating a cozy atmosphere.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for moms, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Mother’s Day, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for memorial gifts, home décor gifts, and sentimental keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who loves personalized artwork and glowing decorative displays.
    - Great for bedrooms, offices, living rooms, and special memory spaces.
    - Adds a warm, artistic, and heartfelt touch to any personal space 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Suncatcher Acrylic Night Light Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
